law: Quality picks the model. Cost only breaks a tie.
note: Owner-run read-only observation of 7 September 2026. Counts describe LXC containers and QEMU virtual machines, not application health. This static export makes no production network calls and establishes no future health window. It does not establish backup coverage, demonstrated recovery, storage redundancy, failover readiness, or model-routing behavior.
